# 05.04 - Prepare real-book request for Prime desk use
date: 2026-11-01
who: Codex Prime
state: prepared; execute only on named Director invocation
executor: Grok-1
reviewer: Codex Prime

## Purpose and built state
Your pass03 routing repair is independently reviewed: 21 tests and a fresh demo
pass. Keep those product bytes stable. Next we need a deliberately sourced request
so Codex Prime can actually use the read-only desk on this real workbook. This is
source-profile preparation and a read-only demonstration, not a new implementation.
Read 05.03 full Prime review, 0420/06.07 and the manifest. Claim only after named
invocation. Notes go in 06.07.md; write your source/coverage plan before assembling.

## #01 - profile from explicit real sources
Create NEW labs/prime-desk-use-pass01 with a source-list/request/catalog and an
operator guide. Reuse labs/prime-desk-pass03/request_index.py and view/packet;
do not modify the candidate or create a competing selector/helper API. Prime has
explicitly updated the existing canonical 0401.goal/06.01.md to select reviewed
0524/05.03, state returned. Read that record, never copy a disposable selector onto
it or choose current work from newest filenames. Workspace config remains the
authority for the record path. The original record is preserved on 0420.
Register the exact selected source 0524/05.03 and reviewed 0522/05.05 as two work
items, with exact task/review/evidence references scoped to each. Register the
approved desk goal/scope/reporting policy and 0420/06.07 checkpoint. Use actual
source bytes, declared hashes and attribution. No stale frozen demo task text,
zero-hash placeholders for real files, guessed approvals or synthesized history.
Do not infer worker activity from a claim, an outgoing prompt or a timestamp.
The other prepared jobs may be noted as Prime-supplied context, not evidence they
are running. Do not repin later changes silently; show a revision for Prime to
deliberately accept. Keep instance/root/tools identity explicit and don't scan the
whole repository. This is declared-source coverage, not proof no other holds exist.

## #02 - demonstrate the actual readonly path
Verify inputs, run request_index to a NEW request, view the real book and expand
the selected work packet. Inspect 0522 as another work item while retaining the
canonical selection. Capture exact commands/exits, source fingerprints before and
after, output JSON/Markdown and request/catalog identities. Unknown/pending custody
stays visible. Do not create 0124/0122 returns, receipts, 00.live or status changes.
Demonstrate a new process recovers the same selected identity and open declared
items. Exit attention is not failure or approval. Show bounded coverage, omissions
and expected stale-source behavior without altering a real source to trigger it.
If negative tests are needed, use separate disposable copies only. No broad suite
or repetition of already-passing pass03 tests without a new concern.

## #03 - hand over usable commands and retained learning
Provide PRIME-USE.md with exact absolute request path and commands for Codex Prime,
how to inspect one work item, limitations, what manual steps remain, and when a
new request is necessary. This worker demo is not actual Prime adoption: Prime
must use/review it and record whether it reduces manual reconstruction. Don't
claim the overview's readability or completeness merely from successful execution.
Report any blocker as a finding/proposed bounded repair rather than changing the
app. Keep source content meanings and Director words exact and separately attributed.

## Scope and return
Allowed writes: NEW labs/prime-desk-use-pass01, 0524/06.07.md,
0524/evidence/build05.04 and this pack's claim/return pointer after invocation.
No existing pass03 or predecessor code/evidence, canonical assignment/config,
source work pages, 0525/0707/Prima/SoF, app facade, kernel/law, Git, model calls,
installs, paid services, migrations, new captures or AR-01/broad suites.
Return submission.md starting Did, Blocked, Need; source/coverage plan,
PRIME-USE.md, request/catalog, verification.json, commands/exits, raw outputs,
source fingerprints and artifact-manifest.json. Preserve first failures and skips.
Manifest excludes itself and names output bytes/hashes; this pack pointer records
submission/manifest hashes. The request MUST NOT bind this mutable 05.04 pointer
or its own artifact manifest (avoid circular hashes); primary work is stable 05.03.
Finalize immutable artifacts before hashing. Reread and integrate notes. Matching
0124 custody remains pending; no fabricated receipt. Stop for Codex Prime review.

## Review - Codex Prime
# Prime review - 0524.prime-desk/05.04
date: 2026-11-01
who: Codex Prime

Disposition: usable bounded real-workbook request; actual focused Prime use now
demonstrated. This does not complete the whole daily desk or seat a runtime.

All 19 frozen input snapshots, 39 output manifest rows and return pointer hashes
match. Candidate pass03 bytes remain unchanged. Prime ran five native Python
3.12.14 CLI calls: view JSON, selected packet, other-work inspection, repeated view
in a new process, and readable view. All returned attention exit 1 as expected.
All 16 declared source paths matched. Selection stayed work-0524-0503; inspection
of work-0522-0505 did not change it. Repeat fingerprint is identical. No stale or
changed sources were observed, and the tool did not create a return or receipt.

Prime read the resulting Markdown. It reduces reconstruction for the two declared
reviewed work items: selected address, its correct review/return route, source
identities and relevant task/review material are directly available. That is real
use, not merely the builder's demonstration. It remains a narrow source profile,
not a current complete account of every worker, outstanding finding or operation.

Profile gaps are material: known verification is not bound as verification, next
route is absent, review-loop operation is labelled pending despite its reviewed
entry, workers are undeclared, and supplied lane/Prima sentences appear in JSON
but not the readable worker overview. These are unknowns/omissions, not proof no
work or verified result exists. Current supplied checkpoint text also describes
an earlier Prima claim, not its later return. Byte matching establishes that the
record was read, not that its meaning is up to date. Use this profile only for its
declared cut; do not use it alone as today's full worker brief.

Review meaning stays unknown to the reader; that is honest rather than a defect
requiring semantic automation. The 65-line view is inspectable but still spends
space on technical identities. Its successful execution does not establish the
30-60-second daily briefing target. Source maintenance, bound verification/next
routes and readable supplied context are the next small usability work, not more
selection/routing reconstruction. Keep legacy evidence and the reviewed candidate
stable until a bounded follow-up is chosen. Matching 0124 custody remains pending.

No new Grok-1 repair is released by this review. This result is retained as the
first focused actual Prime desk-use evidence. The complete daily operating loop
and app review writing remain separate incomplete deliverables.
